title: Where Does Staleness Accumulate? Pool Aware Effective Staleness Control for Asynchronous RL in LLM Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.36830v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves resource utilization in large language model post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but it also introduces policy lag as trajectories are generated and queued while the trainer continues to update. We study how this lag accumulates over a trajectory's lifetime and how it can be controlled without sacrificing the wall-clock benefits of asynchronous execution. We decompose trajectory staleness into Generation Staleness, accumulated before rollout completion, and Waiting Staleness, accumulated after a completed trajectory enters the pool. Motivated by this decomposition, we introduce PACE (Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness). PACE converts excess pool occupancy into an adaptive rejection budget and ranks completed trajectories using an effective-staleness score that combines Waiting Staleness with prefix-aware Generation Staleness. translated_title: 陈旧性在哪里累积？面向大语言模型后训练中异步强化学习的池感知有效陈旧性控制
translated_abstract: 全异步强化学习通过将轨迹生成与策略优化重叠进行，提高了大语言模型后训练阶段的资源利用率，但当训练器持续更新参数时，轨迹会被生成并排队等待，由此引入了策略滞后问题。我们研究了这种滞后在轨迹生命周期内如何累积，以及如何在不牺牲异步执行时间效率的前提下对其进行控制。我们将轨迹陈旧性分解为两部分：生成陈旧性（在轨迹生成完成之前累积）和等待陈旧性（已完成轨迹进入轨迹池后累积）。基于这一分解，我们提出了PACE（池感知的有效陈旧性控制）方法。PACE将轨迹池中的多余占用转化为自适应的拒绝预算，并利用一个结合等待陈旧性与前缀感知生成陈旧性的有效陈旧性评分，对已完成的轨迹进行排序。这避免了……
tldr: 该论文提出PACE方法，首次将异步强化学习中的轨迹陈旧性分解为生成陈旧性与等待陈旧性，并通过池感知的自适应拒绝机制对有效陈旧性进行控制，在不牺牲异步执行效率的前提下缓解大语言模型后训练中的策略滞后问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PACE, which decomposes trajectory staleness into Generation Staleness and Waiting Staleness, and controls effective staleness through a pool-aware adaptive rejection mechanism, mitigating policy lag in asynchronous RL for LLM post-training without sacrificing wall-clock efficiency.
